# Yeshiva Visit to one of them. See docs/spec/v49-yeshiva-visit-from-the-library.md.

kehillah_lib_holders_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_holders
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_holders_work_id value = 1 }
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_registered_communities
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer.primary_title }
				exists = holder
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_holders target = scope:kehillah_lib_holder_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}
